history.prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a thick, complex shipping logbook and a heavy industrial mechanical date stamp on a plain dark slate desk surface. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight. The logbook is slightly askew to look handled, with muted paper tones and illegible cropped columns. A heavy, worn brass date stamping mechanism rests on top of the open pages, casting a soft shadow. Minimalist composition, muted neutral palette, editorial elegance, generous negative space.

style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: An extreme close-up macro photograph of a heavy, brushed-steel industrial timestamp mechanism pressing down onto a thick, textured shipping ledger. 100mm macro lens, razor-sharp focal plane on the metallic numerals of the time dial, shallow depth of field with the background falling away into soft shadow. Visible surface texture, dust motes in the air, soft directional daylight raking across the heavy paper stock. Extreme asymmetry, hero mechanism anchored off-centre on the right third.
negative_prompt: text, typography, numbers, letters, watermark, signature, logo, branding, human face, hands
rationale: The story hinges on specific documents (invoices, regulations) and the exact timestamps recorded on them to settle disputes. An extreme close-up of a physical timestamp on heavy shipping paperwork captures the tactile reality of this critical compliance and billing mechanism.
subject: a mechanical industrial timestamp pressing into heavy shipping paperwork
composition: extreme asymmetry, hero object off-centre on the thirds
alt_text: A heavy industrial timestamp mechanism resting on textured shipping paperwork under directional light.
caption: Under the new rule, the exact time stamps logged by a control tower determine whether a demurrage bill stands.
title: timestamp-shipping-ledger-macro
